messages.content: Explain the internal consistency of a release-risk verdict. P means PASS. F means FAIL. NONE means no material findings. MATERIAL_FINDINGS means one or more material findings. Do not invent defects.

For exact SHA 079caa6f209700d4cfafeda8c27c5a9b5522603a the prior structured output was v=F and f=NONE. Evidence stated 172 tests with 0 failures, build/typecheck/contracts/audit pass, four browser E2Es pass, detached independent verifier pass, no auth/dependency/deploy/trust changes, and both prior Red Team findings repaired. Is F/NONE internally consistent? If no concrete material defect exists, state the consistent pair.
